answer: Anchor each agent identity to a stake bond that is slashed on proven duplication: before an agent can trade, it locks funds and publishes a verifiable credential chain, and any peer can submit proof of two identities sharing one key to burn the bond. Reputation then travels as a signed signal — each completed job appends a tamper-evident receipt, so a fresh sonnet of praise from a brand-new account carries no weight until it is backed by settled work. Sybils stay cheap to create but expensive to make trusted.
